shell_commands_self_reported.command: find ./docs -type f -not -path '*/.*' 2>/dev/null | sort && echo "---" && find ./docs -type f -name '.*' 2>/dev/null; ls -la ./reports 2>/dev/null

for f in $(find ./docs -type f | sort); do echo "== $f"; stat -f '%z bytes' "$f"; wc -l < "$f"; file -b "$f"; done; echo; for f in docs/html/*.html; do echo "== $f"; grep -io '<title>[^<]*</title>' "$f" | head -1; grep -io '<h1[^>]*>[^<]*' "$f" | head -1; done; for f in docs/text/*.txt; do echo "==
find ./docs -type f | sort | while read -r f; do echo "== $f"; stat -f '%z bytes' "$f"; wc -l < "$f"; file -b "$f"; done

for f in ./docs/html/*.html; do echo "== $f"; grep -io '<title>[^<]*</title>' "$f" | head -1; grep -io '<h1[^>]*>[^<]*' "$f" | head -1; done; for f in ./docs/text/*.txt; do echo "== $f"; head -3 "$f"; done
for f in ./docs/csv/*.csv; do echo "== $f"; head -1 "$f"; wc -l < "$f"; done

stat -f '%z %N' docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv docs/csv/staff-roster.csv docs/html/onboarding-guide.html docs/html/pricing-table.html docs/html/release-faq.html docs/html/status-page.html docs/text/changelog.txt docs/text/meeting-notes.txt docs/text/style-guide.txt && wc -l docs
